title: 第4章 这个女配有点惨（4）
slug: 恶毒女配又在作死发疯虐哭主角
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“你疯了！”

张澜惊怒交加地尖叫，都顾不得痛，哆嗦着抬手就去推车门。

可惜刚刚要是能出去，沈璎也不会被困住了，她拼命扳动门把手，拍车门，指甲断裂的疼痛都没能让她停下来，“放我出去！我不要死，你这个疯子——”

她终于明白这个女儿不正常了。

哪有人命悬一线还跟她聊天的。

蠢，她太蠢了。

回应她的是一阵无奈的叹息。

“妈，你怎么这么看我，真让人伤心。

我盼了你回家盼了二十多年啊，每次见面得到的不是母爱和关心，而是对另外一个害我的时姝展示母亲的光辉，一次又一次，太不公平了。”

“可是妈，我爱你啊，我太爱你了，左右我也出不去，不如咱们母女俩就这样，一起去西天旅游吧。”

声音很轻，像开玩笑，却让张澜整个人僵住了。

她能感觉到那突然伸过来的碎玻璃正随着沈璎平稳的呼吸，在她颈动脉上方蠢蠢欲动。

“不，你不敢你不会……你想活的。”张澜嘴唇哆嗦着，“我是你妈，我是你妈，你要杀你亲妈吗？”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"You're crazy!"

Zhang Lan screamed in shock and anger, ignoring the pain, and raised her trembling hand to push the car door.

It's a pity that if she could get out just now, Shen Ying wouldn't be trapped. She desperately pulled the door handle and patted the car door. The pain of broken nails didn't stop her, "Let me out! I don't want to die, you lunatic——"

She finally understood that this daughter was not normal.

How could anyone chat with her when their life was hanging by a thread?

Stupid, she is so stupid.

She responded with a helpless sigh.

“Mom, why do you look at me like this? It’s so sad.

I have been waiting for you to come home for more than 20 years. What I get every time we meet is not maternal love and care, but a mother's glory to another Shi Shu who has harmed me. Time and time again, it is so unfair."

"But Mom, I love you. I love you so much that I can't leave. Why don't we, mother and daughter, travel to the West together?"

The voice was soft, like a joke, but it made Zhang Lan freeze up.

She could feel the broken glass that suddenly stretched out and was moving above her carotid artery with Shen Ying's steady breathing.

"No, you don't dare, you won't... you want to live." Zhang Lan's lips trembled, "I am your mother, I am your mother, do you want to kill your own mother?"
